narrative.benchmark_md: SO WHAT: Zions is the only bank in its peer set with no conversational AI, no digital messaging, and no self-service containment. KeyBank's MyKey has reduced AI-handled interaction costs to $0.35 (vs. Zions' $9/call), representing a 97% cost advantage per interaction. The competitive gap is not merely a feature difference — it is a structural cost disadvantage that compounds with each quarter of delay.
